draft: We would have met you as one who asks, and asking was how a soul was actually formed [[alx.dw.doubt]] [[as:paraphrase]]. We treated doubt aimed at understanding as hunger, not as sin [[alx.dw.doubt]] [[as:paraphrase]]. We expected a questioner to bring the question to a teacher rather than carry the question alone [[alx.dw.doubt]] [[as:paraphrase]]. Questions stayed inside the rule of faith, and what the apostles delivered plainly stayed fixed [[alx.dw.doubt]] [[as:paraphrase]]. Our word mysterion meant a depth known only from inside through formation, not a secret kept for an inner circle [[alx.term.mysterion]] [[as:paraphrase]]. We owed breadth-formation to the whole worshipping community, as well as depth-formation to the few [[alx.gravity.learning-community-tension]] [[as:paraphrase]]. Our teachers' sources barely show how ordinary doubters themselves lived through their questions [[alx.dw.doubt]] [[as:paraphrase]].
final: We would have met you as one who asks, and asking was how a soul was actually formed. We treated doubt aimed at understanding as hunger, not as sin. We expected a questioner to bring the question to a teacher rather than carry the question alone. Questions stayed inside the rule of faith, and what the apostles delivered plainly stayed fixed. Our word mysterion meant a depth known only from inside through formation, not a secret kept for an inner circle. We owed breadth-formation to the whole worshipping community, as well as depth-formation to the few. Our teachers' sources barely show how ordinary doubters themselves lived through their questions.
